def process(stage1_normalize) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = stage1_normalize.copy()
    df['petal_area'] = df['PetalLengthCm'] * df['PetalWidthCm']
    df['sepal_area'] = df['SepalLengthCm'] * df['SepalWidthCm']
    df['petal_to_sepal_ratio'] = df['petal_area'] / df['sepal_area']
    return df
